note: Accessory power (formerly magical power) granted by one accessory, by rarity, plus the three accessories the game scores differently. Hand-entered: the items resource exposes an accessory's rarity but not its accessory power. Everything else in the accessory model is API-derived.
source: Hypixel SkyBlock community wiki, Accessory Power/Mechanics and Template:Max AP

excludedItems.note: Empty on purpose. Several bag items (party hats, cake bag) are classified ACCESSORY by the items resource, and nothing in the API says whether they grant magical power. Excluding them on a hunch would hide buyable XP; the computed-vs-reported MP readout is the check instead.

knownGaps: highest_magical_power is a high-water mark, not a current reading, so computed power can sit below it legitimately.
Divine and Ultimate accessories are listed for completeness; none is obtainable without glitches.
BALLOON_HAT_2024, the Green 5th Anniversary Balloon Hat, sits in a maxed player's bag and appears nowhere in the items resource, so it cannot be catalogued or credited.

The Abiphone contact catalogue holds 71 of the 84 a maxed profile carries. The Abicase is scored off the profile's own contact ids so this costs it nothing, but the missing 13 are contacts we cannot offer.

maximum.note: The wiki's stated ceiling, used as the check on our own. Excludes the extra 240 that dungeon accessories grant only while inside dungeons.

special.note: The only accessories the game scores by anything other than their rarity. Named on the Accessory Power page.

RIFT_PRISM.note: grants 11 accessory power once imbued at Erihann

ABICASE.note: grants 1 accessory power for every 2 Abiphone contacts

climbing.note: Accessories whose rarity climbs in place, through their own mechanic rather than a Recombobulator. The items resource reports where each one starts, so the catalogue values them there and adds the one Recombobulator step it knows about; `forgone` is what that leaves on the table against the rarity the wiki says the accessory finally reaches. Each mechanic is different and none is a purchase that can be priced from the bazaar or the auction house, so they are recorded rather than guessed at.
climbing.source: individual wiki pages and Template:Max AP, read 2026-08-21

items.by: SkyBlock level: common at 25, uncommon at 75, rare at 150, and on up. Takes no Recombobulator.
feeding it Thunder in a Bottle, four rarities' worth
won from Shen's Auction; the wiki cites its mythic form as the maximum. Takes no Recombobulator.
twelve perfect gemstones carry it to legendary, and a Recombobulator then reaches mythic

disproved.by: stated only by the summary table, which flags its own rarities as unreliable
disproved.disprovedBy: A player at the documented maximum of 2,122 accessory power holds an uncommon Farmer Orb, which is a common base plus one Recombobulator. The rare the summary table claims is not reachable, and that table flags its own rarities as unreliable.

unlisted.note: What neither side can name, measured rather than argued: the wiki's trivia counts 147 accessories, its own table lists 121 and names 20 more as missing, and it flags twelve of the rarities it does state as wrong. This is the slack that leaves against our own ceiling, and it is a tolerance for a check rather than a figure to add to anything.
unlisted.history: Was 44 until the Hats of Celebration were merged into one family. We had been counting three, the wiki's tally counts one — so our ceiling had ten magical power in it that the 2,121 never did, and the honest comparison is five wider once five accessories recovered from the wiki's bare-letter rarity fields are added back. Then 52, when the Farmer Orb was struck off the climbing list on a maxed player's evidence: three power the wiki claims and nobody can reach moves from climbing to slack.
